claims: Continue mechanical ventilation in SPONT/PSV mode with current settings (PSV 5-10 cmH2O, PEEP 5 cmH2O, FiO2 titrated to keep SpO2 ≥92%), monitoring tidal volumes, respiratory rate, and work of breathing.
Titrate FiO2 downward from 40-50% as tolerated while maintaining SpO2 ≥92%, reassessing arterial blood gas within 24 hours.
Continue fentanyl infusion at 75 mcg/hour and propofol infusion for sedation, titrating to goal RASS of -1 to 0 and reassessing sedation level regularly.
Obtain daily arterial blood gas to monitor acid-base status (pH 7.34, base excess -5, bicarbonate 20-25) and oxygenation.
Monitor hemodynamics closely given hypotension (NIBP 98-101/32-37 mmHg, MAP 48-51 mmHg); assess volume status and consider vasopressor or fluid support if hypotension persists.
Replete electrolytes as needed (magnesium 1.8 mg/dL, potassium 4.1 mEq/L, calcium 8 mg/dL) and recheck levels within 24 hours.
Continue stress ulcer prophylaxis with famotidine and VTE prophylaxis per protocol.
Maintain head-of-bed elevation, perform oral care with chlorhexidine, and continue subglottal suctioning to reduce VAP risk.
Implement pressure injury prevention with regular repositioning and skin assessment given Braden score indicating high risk (immobile, bedfast, poor nutrition).
Continue enteral nutrition via NG tube with aspiration precautions and monitor tolerance, given poor nutritional status.
